title: Bug 8845 Old Prices Calculated in Req. Worksheet
summary: When other fields on a Requisition Line are validated, Order Date is no longer set to a date before the work date, so prices are calculated correctly. Starting Date is now only updated through validation, so validating Order Date from code no longer sets it directly.
key_points: Validating other Requisition Line fields no longer sets Order Date earlier than the work date
Fixes outdated prices calculated in the requisition worksheet
Starting Date is only set through validation, keeping Starting Date-Time in sync
New test in SCMPlanReqWksht and existing tests adjusted that relied on past order dates
quote: Does not set Order Date in Requisition Line to an older date than workdate when validating other fields, to make the price calculations correct.
